steps.text: The fast growth of adolescence needs good fuel — a balanced diet. Let's build one.
Tap each nutrient to see why the growing body needs it.
Proteins build the body, iron makes healthy blood, calcium strengthens bones, and vitamins keep everything working. Plenty of water matters too.
A balanced diet has a bit of everything — not too much of junk food. That's what supports healthy growth during these years.

coach.mission: Build a balanced diet for a growing adolescent.
whenStuck: Tap each nutrient to learn what it does for the body.
Aim for a bit of everything — a balanced plate.
whenWrong: A balanced diet needs proteins, iron, calcium, vitamins, and water — not just one thing.
Too much junk food doesn't give the body what it needs to grow.
whenCorrect: Right — that nutrient supports healthy growth.
Good — a balanced plate has a bit of everything.
coach.done: You've built a balanced diet for adolescence. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
